description: Marine buoy observations — Latest offshore and coastal observations from NOAA National Data Buoy Center stations: wind direction/speed/gusts (kt and mph), wave height (ft and m), dominant and average wave period, wave direction, sea state, pressure and 3-hour tendency, air, water and dew-point temperature (F), visibility and tide, plus a small-boat conditions note. Missing values in the newest report are filled from readings in the previous ~90 minutes (listed in filledFromEarlierReadings). Pass an NDBC station= id (e.g. 46026, 41009) or place= / lat=&lon= for the nearest stations; optional limit= 1-5, max_miles= (default 200). Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: weather_buoy
